name: 28_open_bag_zipper
title: Unzipping and Accessing Bag Contents
summary: A dual-arm robot unzips a beige pouch, takes out a blue container, places it back inside, closes the lid, and later reopens the bag to retrieve it.
robot: two black robotic arms with parallel grippers

segments.instruction: The right gripper pulls the zipper around the front curve while the left gripper holds the bag steady.
The right gripper finishes unzipping the remaining track to completely release the top flap.
The left gripper lifts open the top flap to reveal a small blue container inside, and the right gripper lifts the container out onto the table.
The right gripper places the blue container back into the bag, and the left gripper folds the lid shut.
segments.memory_event: hide: blue container placed inside the bag and covered by the closed lid

segments.instruction: Both grippers press down gently along the closed lid and shift the bag slightly toward the center.
The left gripper straightens the front strap of the bag while the right arm retracts to clear the top.
The left gripper lifts open the lid of the bag again.
segments.memory_event: return: the blue container reappears inside the bag in the exact same spot and orientation

segments.instruction: The right gripper reaches inside and grasps what was put inside the bag.
